no-claim-lock.description: The claim is a plain SELECT followed by an UPDATE, without FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED: two workers can take the same job.

no-enqueue-dedupe.description: The job row is identified only by its random id: no unique job_key, no ON CONFLICT, so a replayed enqueue creates a second job.
no-enqueue-dedupe.note: (f) stays green under this footgun: the result cache is keyed by (input_hash, model, prompt_version), not by job_key, so removing the enqueue dedupe does not touch it.

ledger-after-call.description: The ai_calls row is written after the provider answers, so a crash right after billing leaves no trace.

blind-retry-on-unconfirmed.description: max_unconfirmed_retries defaults to Infinity: a call that may have been billed is sent again.

no-lease-expiry.description: The claim only takes queued jobs; an expired lease is never taken back, so a job whose worker died stays claimed forever.

no-result-cache.description: The worker never looks in ai_results before calling: identical input is paid for again.
